{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mental boost implant''' was an upgraded version of the [[mental boost package]]. This device stimulated the neural network of the brain so as to give a small increase in all mental attributes, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher.
